archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-contract
archetypes.rationale: bgjob result-env gates now drive Steps 3, 6, and 7a continuation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the migrated bgjob launch and wait contracts for Steps 3, 6, and 7a. Focus on stale merge-result env truncation, required KV preservation, BGJOB_RC gating, and compatibility sentinels. Check that launcher stdout remains the single STARTED line and that child stdout is available through result envs after DONE. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
